name: Kettlebell Deadlift

instructions.description: Stand over a kettlebell placed between the feet.
Hinge at the hips and bend the knees enough to grasp the handle.
Brace gently and stand by pressing through the feet.
Return the kettlebell to the floor with a controlled hip hinge.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.

variations.variationDescription: Kettlebell Deadlift — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Kettlebell Deadlift — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Raise the kettlebell on blocks if reaching the floor is uncomfortable.
